hints.title: Delayed Asynchronous Resolution
hints.text: JavaScript executes on a single event loop without blocking the main thread. How can an asynchronous operation delay execution for a specified duration before resolving?

hints.title: Timer Resolution Wrapping
hints.text: Wrapping a browser or runtime timer callback inside a returned Promise allows consumers to pause execution cleanly using standard asynchronous syntax.

hints.title: Promise Constructor with Timer
hints.text: Instantiate and return a new Promise whose executor function schedules a setTimeout callback after the specified millis. The timer callback invokes the promise resolve function.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Zero CPU consumption while awaiting timer expiration.
